name: Moto Yuusha no Yuuutsu
source:
The battle between the Demon King and the heroes is over,
Peace came to the world,
One man was left behind.

[From [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/17436]Freem![/url]]

魔王與勇者們的戰鬥結束了，
世界迎來了和平，
唯獨留下了一個男人。
